fields: The fight depends on his active weapons. Once his red and white guns are empty, he loses his dueling power and becomes easy to burst.
Every arrow slows you and keeps you out of range. She has no escapes, but walking up to farm is risky unless your support is a tank who can protect you.
She pokes you from long range whenever you go for minions. Let her push toward your tower so your support has room to engage and catch her.
His escape dash is slow and straight, so your support can easily catch him for a burst.
His early axe damage stops you from farming safely. You can aim W at where his axes will land, but never fight him alone early.
He pokes from range and blinks away when you approach. Stand behind your minions to block his skillshots.
She has no escapes, making her easy for your support to catch. Burst her quickly, since a takedown gives her passive speed to flee.
Her hops make your skillshots hard to land. A slow or Exhaust from your support strips her mobility and makes her easy to kill.
Fragile and immobile; any stun from your support usually kills him. Back off while his W is active, since it greatly extends his range.
Same short range as you but much higher early burst. He falls off later, so survive the early lane and you win.
She dominates early because her Q bounces through your minions when you farm. When she channels her ult she is stationary, so use your ult to dash through and kill her.
Her shorter range lets you poke her. Step back while her W makes her immune to your autos.
Her wind wall deletes your W, and her range is even shorter than yours, so attack her from a safe distance before she closes in.
She is very squishy and cannot survive your burst when she farms. End before her souls give her huge range.
Her short range and predictable waveclear let you keep the wave near your tower. Bait her spell shield before using your main damage.
His early game is very weak, so bully him off minions. Close the game before his fireball upgrades take over fights.
Her bomb hits hard and she jumps away if you fight back. She pushes fast, so let the wave come to you and farm safely.
He ambushes from stealth with high attack speed. Use an Oracle Lens to reveal him before he surprises you.
His long-range arrows pierce your wave and take big chunks. He is slow and fragile, so a support stun usually kills him.
Both of you are short-ranged scalers. Your burst is much faster early, giving you the advantage in short fights.
She roots you by recalling feathers. Use your ult to dash behind her and avoid the feather line to win the duel.
Her crits add magic damage and a stacked Q makes her autos splash heavily. Pressure her early before she stacks, since late game she outranges and melts you.
Her autos are blocked by minions, so stand behind your wave. She can slide over walls, so your support must stun her quickly.
